title: Galaxy pill button
description: Fully rounded pill buttons: a solid one in the primary colour (white on the dark theme) with a trailing arrow that slides half its width on hover, and an outline one whose 1px border takes a signal colour (green, orange or blue) and washes faintly with it on hover.
notes: hover timing is the original's 0.3s ease-in-out
name: galaxy-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: solid: primary fill with a trailing arrow · outline: a 1px coloured ring, no arrow

props.name: tone
props.description: the outline's colour: highlight (green), chart-1 (orange) or chart-2 (blue)

props.name: arrow
props.description: show the trailing arrow on a solid button (on by default)

props.name: onClick
props.description: called on click (only when it renders a button)
